ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים הָאֱמוּנָה שֶׁל אָדָם עוֹמֶדֶת בְּמִבְחָן קָשֶׁה.
ideas.children_en: God tested Abraham. Abraham answered quickly, showing he was ready to obey.

ideas.children_he: הַסִּפּוּר מַעֲלֶה שְׁאֵלוֹת קָשׁוֹת עַל אֱמוּנָה וְעַל אַהֲבַת הוֹרִים.
ideas.children_en: God told Abraham to take his son Isaac to a special land to offer him as a sacrifice. The place is connected to today's Jerusalem.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם הִתְכּוֹנֵן לְמַסָּע קָשֶׁה וְלֹא יָדַע אֵיךְ יִסְתַּיֵּם.
ideas.children_en: Abraham quickly got ready: he organized a donkey, servants, and wood, and started a long journey. On the third day, he saw the place from far away.

ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק וְאַבְרָהָם הָלְכוּ יַחַד, אֲבָל לְכָל אֶחָד הָיוּ מַחְשָׁבוֹת מִשֶּׁלּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Abraham told the servants to stay, and he and Isaac went alone. Isaac carried the wood; Abraham carried the fire and knife.

ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק שָׁאַל שְׁאֵלָה חֲשׁוּבָה, וְאַבְרָהָם הִשִׁיב לוֹ בְּאֱמוּנָה.
ideas.children_en: Isaac asked where the sheep was. Abraham said God would find it. Isaac kept going with him, even though he was scared.

ideas.children_he: זֶהוּ רֶגַע מְפַחֵד בַּסִּפּוּר, שֶׁמַּדְגִּישׁ כַּמָּה חַיָּיו שֶׁל יֶלֶד יְקָרִים.
ideas.children_en: At the place, Abraham built an altar, tied Isaac and laid him there, and got ready to kill him.

ideas.children_he: הַמַּלְאָךְ עָצַר אֶת אַבְרָהָם, וְיִצְחָק נִשְׁאַר בַּחַיִּים.
ideas.children_en: The angel of God stopped Abraham before killing. It showed he obeyed by not hurting his son.

ideas.children_he: הָאַיִל הוּקְרַב בִּמְקוֹם יִצְחָק. הַסִּפּוּר מִסְתַּיֵּם בְּהַצָּלָה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham found a ram caught in bushes and offered it instead of Isaac. He named the place 'God sees'.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם שָׁמַע שׁוּב הַבְטָחָה לְעָתִיד שֶׁל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The angel promised to bless Abraham because he did not keep his son back. His children will be many, and people will bless them.

ideas.children_he: אַחֲרֵי מַסָּע קָשֶׁה אֶפְשָׁר לַחֲזֹר הַבַּיְתָה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham returned with his servants to Be'er Sheva and lived there for many years.

ideas.children_he: מִשְׁפָּחוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת מְחַבְּרוֹת בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים גַּם מִמֶּרְחָק.
ideas.children_en: Abraham learned his brother Nahor had many children, including Rebecca who later married Isaac.
